II  •  About Me

About me.

PORTFOLIO 2026
The Hook

I am a General Virtual Assistant and GoHighLevel specialist who helps coaches and service businesses build backend systems that work without them having to manage every detail. My corporate operations background is not a detour. It is the reason clients trust me with their business.

The Story

After 7 years at Tambunting Pawnshop processing high-volume financial records under strict compliance standards, I saw how much precision matters in business operations. I took that discipline and applied it to remote work: building funnels, managing CRM pipelines, setting up automations, and keeping operations running cleanly. I did not just career-shift. I leveled up.

The Promise

When you hire me, you get someone who responds within 4 business hours, delivers on time, and never lets a task fall through the cracks. I treat your business like it matters because it does.

VI  •  Case Study One

SkillStack Academy Funnel Build

PORTFOLIO 2026
skillstackacademy.com  •  Sales Page + Masterclass
GoHighLevel  •  Funnel Build  •  Copywriting
GoHighLevelSales FunnelOpt-in PageCopy
Turn Your VA Work Into a High Value Skill in Just a Few Steps
Problem
The client had a GoHighLevel course ready but no sales funnel to sell it. They needed a complete, launch-ready system built from scratch including the sales page, masterclass section and a clear path to enrolment.
What I did
Built a multi-section GHL funnel including a conversion-focused hero, pain-point section ("Does any of this sound familiar?"), masterclass overview with outcome bullets, module breakdown and a prominent enrolment CTA. All copy was written to move a cold visitor toward a buying decision.
Result
Launch-ready funnel delivered with zero revision requests. Full buyer journey covered from cold traffic to enrolment in a single build.
VII  •  Case Study Two

Upsell Flow and Thank You Page

PORTFOLIO 2026
skillstackacademy.com  •  Upsell + Thank You Page
GoHighLevel  •  Post-Purchase Flow
Upsell PageOrder FormThank You Page
Build Faster With Ready-to-Use Funnel Templates
Problem
After the main purchase, there was no upsell offer or proper onboarding. Buyers were leaving without being offered the next step and arriving in the course with no welcome experience.
What I did
Built the complete post-purchase flow. The upsell page offered the GHL Funnel Templates Pack at $97 with an embedded order form capturing all buyer details. The thank-you page delivered a branded "You're All Set, Welcome In" moment with clear next steps and a back-to-home CTA.
Result
A seamless post-enrolment experience that increases revenue per buyer and delivers a professional first impression inside the course.
VII-B  •  Automation

Appointment Automation System

PORTFOLIO 2026
app.gohighlevel.com  •  Workflow Automation Builder
GoHighLevel  •  CRM  •  Automation
Workflow BuildSMS + EmailNo-Show Recovery
Booking Confirmation and No-Show Recovery Workflows
Problem
The client was manually following up on every appointment confirmation and every no-show. Leads were being lost and the team was spending hours on tasks a system should handle.
What I did
Built two GHL workflows. The Booking Confirmation flow sends an email confirmation, SMS reminder, and updates the opportunity pipeline automatically. The No-Show Recovery flow triggers a follow-up email, SMS nudge, task assignment and lead re-tagging when a prospect does not show. Both branch by real-time appointment status.
Result
Saved an estimated 5+ hours per week and eliminated manual follow-up entirely. Zero leads lost after a missed appointment.
